title: Header builder for computer and phone
problem: The store header was fixed: no way to place the search, categories, hotline or cart, or to make a phone header.
now: Several saved headers, each with three rows and three areas for computer and phone, sixteen elements, sticky rows, a phone drawer and bottom bar.
steps: Press Add in the main row's right area and pick Hotline
Switch to Phone, turn the bottom bar on and tick Search
Press Publish header and open the store on a phone-sized window

shots.label: Header builder: rows and areas, computer and phone
